summary: KE Holdings, the NYSE/HKEX-listed Chinese real-estate platform, filed a Form 6-K furnishing five consecutive Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns dated Oct 5–9, 2026, disclosing daily changes in issued shares tied to an ongoing open-market buyback. Prior repurchases (May–June 2026) were executed at HKD 36.08–45.01 per share and one US tranche at USD 5.7206, with shares redeemed but not yet cancelled, implying a modest cancellation overhang. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The repetitive filing pattern signals a systematic capital-return program; watch for continued daily disclosures, cancellation timing, and buyback pace relative to free float.
